name: run-incident-response
job: Run production incident response to mitigation and truthful close: declare, stabilize, communicate, diagnose, resolve, learn.

inScope: Declaring severity, scope, impact, and command owner
Communicating facts-only status with no false ETAs
Diagnosing the owning cause, landing the fix, and writing a short postmortem
outOfScope: Working as designed when users are still harmed

inputs: Live outage, elevated error rate, data loss risk, or security incident
outputs: Postmortem with action items and owners
failureSemantics: Mitigation comes before diagnosis; working as designed is not resolution while users are harmed; live metrics are never invented and telemetry gaps are reported.

outcome.observable: An incident record with mitigation evidence, facts-only stakeholder communications, an owning-cause fix or permanent mitigation, and a postmortem with action items and owners.
